guidance: Review all GuardDuty findings — not just critical ones. Investigating medium and low severity findings helps detect early reconnaissance and compromise attempts. Enable GuardDuty Protection Plans as appropriate: Runtime Monitoring for process-level visibility on EC2/ECS/EKS, Malware Protection for agentless EBS volume scanning, S3 Protection for adversarial S3 activity, and RDS Protection for Aurora login attacks.
how_to_check: Are findings reviewed across all severity levels, not just critical? Are medium/low findings investigated for reconnaissance or early compromise? Are relevant Protection Plans enabled (Runtime Monitoring, Malware Protection, S3, RDS)? For more information, please refer to the documentation.
